qs.q: Which of the following is a characteristic feature of Schwachman–Diamond Syndrome?
o: Red cell precursor infection via P antigen.
qs.e: Exocrine pancreatic dysfunction is an invariable feature of Schwachman–Diamond Syndrome. GPI anchor deficiency is seen in PNH, multinuclear erythroblasts in CDA, and P antigen infection in Parvovirus B19.
